title: Spa Manager
description:
About The Garcia Heritage

The Garcia Heritage is a premium spa and wellness centre in Anand, Gujarat, r

About the Role

We are looking for a Spa Manager to help run our day-to-day spa operations and guide our therapists and front-desk team. You will work directly with the co-founders and be responsible for guest experience, service quality and a smooth, well-organised spa. Female candidates are preferred for this role.

Responsibilities

• Manage daily spa operations, bookings and guest flow

• Welcome guests and make sure every guest has a comfortable experience

• Create staff schedules and supervise therapists and reception staff

• Maintain hygiene, cleanliness and service standards in all treatment rooms

• Handle guest feedback politely and professionally

• Keep track of supplies, inventory and daily reports

• Support the co-founders with offers, promotions and team training

Requirements

• Freshers are welcome to apply. Prior experience in a spa, salon or hospitality role is a plus, but not required

• Good communication in Gujarati and Hindi (basic English is a plus)

• Polite, confident and well-groomed, with a responsible attitude

• Willingness to learn and take on leadership

• Candidates from Anand, Vadodara, Nadiad and nearby areas preferred

• Diploma or certification in spa management or hospitality is a plus, but not mandatory

What We Offer

• Full on-the-job training for freshers

• Competitive salary with performance incentives

• A respectful, safe and supportive work environment

• Real growth opportunities as the business expands

How to Apply

Apply on LinkedIn or call 9737838846
